description: Get a value from a running cache instance by key. Returns the stored value (string or deserialized JSON object) or null if the key does not exist or has expired. Read-only — no side effects. Use cache_mget when you need multiple keys in one round-trip. Use cache_exists to check existence without retrieving the value. Use semantic_search when you need fuzzy/vector search across stored values.

org_id.description: Optional org ID — if the direct key misses, falls back to the shared org namespace org:{org_id}:sem:{key}

name: cache_get
